# Example FAQ content

A small, self-contained example dataset in the strict `Q:/CAT:/.../A:`
import format — used by the import/export tests as a stand-in for a real
admin's content. Entirely fictional (fake names, fake contacts, fake
account numbers that happen to pass the same checksum rules a real one
would) so it can be committed and read by anyone who clones the repo.

Format extensions used below:
- `TYPE:` `answer` (default) or `router`
- `VIS:` `public` (default) or `dm_only`
- `REVIEW:` ISO date after which admins are reminded to verify this entry
- `CHILDREN:` slugs, router entries only

---

